proposals.evidence: DEDR 2826 gives Tamil aintu/añcu, Malayalam añcu, Kota anj, Kodagu añji and Kannada/Telugu ayidu ‘five’. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
